Talia (Reliability): Quick post-all-hands follow-up on the reliability segment. RCA: https://internal.redwood.com/rca/INC-2290011. Posting a short owner list so we can wrap up.

Marcus (CTO): Thanks. Leadership asks for: 1) a plain-language customer blurb, 2) an internal one-pager for execs with estimated customer impact and next steps.

Ibrahim (SRE): I can draft the customer blurb. Will include "what happened" + mitigation + next steps. ETA: 2290011800.

Yumi (Product): We need to decide whether this requires an immediate hotfix or we add it to the planned cache work. Any data on recurrence risk?

Talia (Reliability): Short summary: configuration drift triggered a cache fallback under a rare load pattern. Patch fixed the drift; recurrence probability low but non-zero. Recommend patch + regression test now; refactor scoped in next sprint.

Hector (Finance): Quick Q: do we expect SLA credits or material customer refunds? Need a ballpark for revenue ops.

Maya (Legal): Please run customer wording past me before publishing; also avoid phrasing that suggests admission of systemic failure until we finish impact calc. Use template: /templates/incident-comms.md
